mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.voucher_id AS voucherId, v.title AS voucherTitle, v.sub_title AS voucherSubTitle, v.shop_id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, v.pay_value AS payValue, v.actual_value AS actualValue, o.status AS status, o.create_time AS createTime FROM tb_voucher_order o JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id = o.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT 100
